name: Dropbox (GC-shared plan folders)
purpose: Several GCs (Summit GC among them) distribute plan sets as public Dropbox folder links inside the ITB email.

auth.notes: Links are public; no Dropbox account required to fetch.

trigger.detail: on ITB import when body contains a dropbox.com link

known_limits: Folder links need '?dl=1' handling and can be large; download must be size-capped and logged.
owner_action_required: Not yet built. Next step: auto-detect dropbox.com links during ITB intake and mirror the folder into plans/<project>/.
